name: Alice no Omochabako
original_name: アリスのおもちゃばこ
source:
"Cardfight! Wisteria!"
Leon proposes to play a card game when Alice is visiting him one day.

"Otsukai Quest"
Welsh, a busy baker. Alice and Leaf help buy him ingredients.

"Uchinuke☆Love Attack!"
Lupine tries his best to convey words of love to Alice who doesn't quite get it.

"Yoikono Fun Quiz Class"
Financier and Alice take a break from paperwork and take a quiz on "Midori no Himegimi".

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10213]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“Cardfight! Wisteria!”
Leon在Alice某天拜访他时，提议玩一场卡牌游戏。

“跑腿任务☆”
忙碌的面包师Welsh。Alice和Leaf帮忙购买食材。

“穿心☆Love Attack!”
Lupine努力向不太理解状况的Alice传达爱意。

“乖孩子趣味问答课”
Financier和Alice暂时放下文书工作，参加关于《绿色公主》的问答。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10213]Freem![/url]]
